anomalies.observed: C35 is drawn on the VMOT input rail of the LM2576HV5-5 buck (U3) together with the other input capacitors, and its value/rating field reads '1000uF 10V solid'. Its rail neighbours and the input protection are high-voltage parts: C27/C28 '47uF 63V solid', C34 '4.7uF 100V', and the input TVS D26 'SMAJ51A'.
anomalies.expected: A bulk capacitor on the VMOT motor-bus input must be rated for the rail it sits on (the 63 V/100 V neighbouring input capacitors and the 51 V-standoff TVS on the same net show this rail is a roughly 36–48 V bus). The part should be a >=63 V rated capacitor, not a 10 V one; the intended 1000 uF 10 V 'solid' bulk capacitor belongs on the 5 V output (with C33/C38, 47 uF 16 V).

evidence.quote: C35 1000uF 10V solid  (Power sheet, input side of U3 LM2576HV5-5)
C27 47uF 63V solid / C28 47uF 63V solid / C34 4.7uF 100V / D26 SMAJ51A on the same VMOT rail

anomalies.impact: On the first application of the ~36–48 V motor-bus input, the 10 V-rated aluminium/polymer capacitor is over-voltage by ~4–5x and will be destroyed (rupture/short), potentially taking out the input rail, the LM2576HV and the board's 5 V supply.

anomalies.observed: The +12 V boost converter U12 (VIN from +5 V, SW via L2 10 uH, D11 MBR0530, output net labelled '+12 V', output cap C19 1 uF 25 V) has its feedback divider drawn as R17 = 100K (output to FB) and R16 = 20K (FB to GND), i.e. a ratio of 5:1.
anomalies.expected: A small 5-pin boost converter of this type uses a ~1.23 V feedback reference, so a 12 V output requires a divider ratio of about 8.8:1 (e.g. 100K/11.3K or 174K/20K). With 100K/20K the loop regulates to roughly 1.23 V x (1 + 100/20) ~= 7.4 V, which does not match the '+12 V' labelling of the net or the 25 V-rated output capacitor.

evidence.quote: R17 100K / R16 20K around U12 FB, output net labelled +12V (Power sheet)

anomalies.impact: If U12's reference is ~1.23 V, the '+12 V' rail will sit near 7.4 V instead of 12 V, weakening/incorrectly driving the 12 V alarm outputs on connector J12 and any external 12 V load.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains at least one power-path deviation: the 1000 uF bulk capacitor C35 is a 10 V-rated part placed on the ~36-48 V VMOT input rail of the LM2576HV buck (alongside 63 V/100 V input capacitors and a 51 V TVS), where it will be over-voltage and destroyed; a second, lower-confidence concern is the U12 boost feedback divider (100K/20K) which does not produce the labelled +12 V.
